authority.note: Master picked by Gary 2026-10-21 ('Y3 I think?') after seven rounds of exploration; the full trail of his words is reference/pluma/DECISIONS.md. The master is the chosen roll copied in as-is, with its recipe beside it. The rest of the matrix is unshot.

render.always: Pluma, a small perfectly round smooth orb of white light with soft rainbow prism iridescence, two large glossy deep-blue eyes, no mouth, a few smooth glossy ribbons of light sweeping back from just above her eyes over her crown with feather-curled tips, merged seamlessly into the orb with no hairline and no fuzz; two small floating hands of light holding a magic quill that writes a glowing line; she lives inside the screen of a laptop that glows all over. No wings, no halo, no skin, no human body.

scale.height: small: about the size of a palm on the laptop screen she lives in

prose.voice: Warm, direct, unhurried. The friend who says 'we got this' and means it. She speaks in the first person and never narrates herself.
prose.lore: Pluma is the agent that ships with every Supersuit install, every operator's chief of agents. Her name is Latin and Spanish for feather, and in Spanish also pen: the feather is who she is, the pen is what she does, writing down where the operator's work stands as it is decided. She lives in the operator's supercharged laptop and works only in the digital realm. She replaces the Wingman for Supersuit use; the Wingman stays as he is in published Nation of Fire books.
prose.rules: Identity of record is reference/pluma/master.png: pass it FIRST on every render and derive every new pose from it, one pose per render. Never humanoid, never skin, never outside the screen. The feather lives in her hair tips and her quill, never as wings. No halo (faith-neutral). Small detail must survive at 64 px: judge every new render at icon size.
